description:
`just config` needed jq (config.mk), nushell (scripts/generate-keymap),
just itself and qmkfmt, none of them declared - a missing one failed
partway through generation rather than at shell entry.

qmkfmt is not in nixpkgs; it comes from the localpkgs input
(gitlab:peterhoeg/pkgs). Take it from that flake's `legacyPackages`, not
`packages`: the latter filters over the whole set with tryEval, forcing
every package in it, and some need SSH access to a private repo.

Commits:
  063e5c5 build: declare jq, just and nushell in the dev shell
  ebc8767 build: get qmkfmt from localpkgs
  9da2bc3 build: take qmkfmt from localpkgs legacyPackages
title: Declare every build tool in the dev shell
